s2:Enhancement of lithium in red clump stars by the additional energy loss induced
s2:Lithium Abundances from the LAMOST Medium-resolution Survey Data Release 9

rationale: The direct candidates provide insights into lithium abundances in giants and potential mechanisms for lithium enrichment, contributing evidence relevant to the question about lithium in exoplanet atmospheres, but do not fully resolve the implications of the observed transmission spectrum on lithium abundance.
